frameworks.summary: PyTorch Kokoro voicepacks (dayour/kokoro, the hexgrad/kokoro fork). Pack ids look like af_heart. This package checks the pack id, language, speed, and weighted blend. It does not load .pt weights.

kokoro-onnx v1: kokoro-v1.0.onnx plus a voices .bin that is an npz of named style vectors. Blend is a weighted sum of those vectors. The existing synthesizer speaks a single pack id when the local model files are present.

Misaki grapheme-to-phoneme front end used by Kokoro. A G2P config, not a waveform voice. English takes a US/GB variant, optional espeak fallback, and a custom lexicon. This package does not import misaki.

VibeVoice long-form multi-speaker TTS (1.5B and Large/7B). Voices are reference WAVs named <lang>-<Name>_<gender>[_bgm].wav, at most 4 speakers, Speaker N scripts, CFG scale, and diffusion steps. The experimental synth in adapters.py stays gated and does not read this schema.

VibeVoice-Realtime 0.5B, the streaming family this repo calls livevoice. One speaker, a .pt KV-cache preset under streaming_model/ or experimental_voices/<lang>/. Not the LiveVoice interpreting product.

NVIDIA PersonaPlex-7B (nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1), a gated full-duplex speech-to-speech model. A stock .pt voice prompt plus a text role prompt. Weights are not bundled; the adapter returns a plan and a mock offline request.
